content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in El Paso

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma with five years of experience. Review PMI's formal prerequisites now to ensure you meet education and hours worked in directing and guiding project tasks.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and cover the full PMBOK Guide framework and exam domains at your own pace within our course window.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the 35-hour course, apply directly through PMI's portal with your education and work history. Pay the examination fee and await PMI's review of your credentials. Processing typically takes several business days; you'll receive confirmation and exam eligibility details by email.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides, to reinforce key concepts. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. Sit for the computer-based test at an authorized testing center and receive your results immediately upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) by taking courses, attending seminars, or engaging in project-management activities. Before your renewal date, submit your PDU record and pay the recertification fee to keep your credential active.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
